# Global Sum Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement global `sum()` in `src/reduction/sum.rs`, including empty-input identity semantics, rank-0 passthrough, checked integer accumulation, and IEEE 754 behavior for floats.

**Architecture:** `sum.rs` owns the scalar reduction baseline. The global `sum()` method must dispatch integer element types to checked accumulation and floating-point element types to ordinary accumulation. Integer overflow must return `Err(XenonError::ArithmeticOverflow)` instead of wrapping. Floating-point `sum()` preserves standard IEEE 754 behavior and returns `Ok(...)`.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, `TensorBase`, `Numeric`, `XenonError`, `crate::private::Sealed`

**Design Docs:** `design/00-coding.md` §4, `design/03-element.md` §5.7, `design/13-reduction.md` §5.1, §6.1, §6.2, §6.3

**Prerequisites:** W17T1 must be complete.

```rust
use xenon::error::XenonError;
use xenon::tensor::Tensor;

#[test]
fn test_sum_i32() {
    let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec([4], vec![1_i32, 2, 3, 4]).unwrap();

    assert_eq!(tensor.sum().unwrap(), 10);
}

#[test]
fn test_sum_empty() {
    let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec([0], Vec::<i32>::new()).unwrap();

    assert_eq!(tensor.sum().unwrap(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn test_sum_float_uses_standard_path() {
    let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec([3], vec![1.5_f64, 2.0, 3.5]).unwrap();

    assert_eq!(tensor.sum().unwrap(), 7.0);
}

#[test]
fn test_sum_integer_overflow_returns_error() {
    let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec([2], vec![i8::MAX, 1_i8]).unwrap();

    assert!(matches!(tensor.sum(), Err(XenonError::ArithmeticOverflow)));
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the complete global-sum implementation**

Create `src/reduction/sum.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::element::{Element, Numeric};
use crate::error::XenonError;
use crate::private::Sealed;
use crate::storage::Storage;
use crate::tensor::TensorBase;

trait CheckedSum: Numeric + Sealed + Copy {
    fn checked_add(lhs: Self, rhs: Self) -> Result<Self, XenonError>;
}

macro_rules! impl_checked_sum_for_int {
    ($($t:ty),* $(,)?) => {
        $(
            impl CheckedSum for $t {
                #[inline]
                fn checked_add(lhs: Self, rhs: Self) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
                    lhs.checked_add(rhs).ok_or(XenonError::ArithmeticOverflow)
                }
            }
        )*
    };
}

macro_rules! impl_checked_sum_for_float {
    ($($t:ty),* $(,)?) => {
        $(
            impl CheckedSum for $t {
                #[inline]
                fn checked_add(lhs: Self, rhs: Self) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
                    Ok(lhs + rhs)
                }
            }
        )*
    };
}

impl_checked_sum_for_int!(i8, i16, i32, i64, isize, u8, u16, u32, u64, usize);
impl_checked_sum_for_float!(f32, f64);

fn sum_int<I>(iter: impl Iterator<Item = I>) -> Result<I, XenonError>
where
    I: CheckedSum,
{
    let mut acc = I::zero();

    for value in iter {
        acc = I::checked_add(acc, value)?;
    }

    Ok(acc)
}

fn sum_floating<A>(iter: impl Iterator<Item = A>) -> A
where
    A: Numeric + Copy,
{
    iter.fold(A::zero(), |acc, value| acc + value)
}

macro_rules! impl_sum_for_int {
    ($($t:ty),* $(,)?) => {
        $(
            impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D>
            where
                S: Storage<Elem = $t>,
                D: Dimension,
            {
                pub fn sum(&self) -> Result<$t, XenonError> {
                    if self.ndim() == 0 {
                        return Ok(*self.iter().next().expect("rank-0 tensor must contain one element"));
                    }

                    if self.is_empty() {
                        return Ok(<$t as Element>::zero());
                    }

                    sum_int(self.iter().copied())
                }
            }
        )*
    };
}

macro_rules! impl_sum_for_float {
    ($($t:ty),* $(,)?) => {
        $(
            impl<S, D> TensorBase<S, D>
            where
                S: Storage<Elem = $t>,
                D: Dimension,
            {
                pub fn sum(&self) -> Result<$t, XenonError> {
                    if self.ndim() == 0 {
                        return Ok(*self.iter().next().expect("rank-0 tensor must contain one element"));
                    }

                    if self.is_empty() {
                        return Ok(<$t as Element>::zero());
                    }

                    Ok(sum_floating(self.iter().copied()))
                }
            }
        )*
    };
}

impl_sum_for_int!(i8, i16, i32, i64, isize, u8, u16, u32, u64, usize);
impl_sum_for_float!(f32, f64);
```
